user.title: Connect to your SIEGENIA door
user.description: Enter the address of your door and the credentials of a user account configured on it.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the door on your local network.
data_description.username: A user account configured on the door. Use a dedicated account: the door allows only one session per account, so sharing one with the SIEGENIA app makes the two disconnect each other.
data_description.port: Leave at 443 unless you have changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with your SIEGENIA door
reauth_confirm.description: The door at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your SIEGENIA door
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches this door.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the address is correct and that the door is reachable on your network.
error.session_occupied: Another client is already signed in with this account. Close the SIEGENIA app, or set up a dedicated account on the door for Home Assistant.
error.wrong_device_type: This is a SIEGENIA {device_type}, not an automatic door. This integration only supports the ACS door family.

abort.already_configured: This door is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address entered points at a different door than the one this entry was set up for.

daymode_unsupported.message: This door does not report day/night mode, so it cannot be locked or unlocked from Home Assistant. Firmware 1.11 and later removed this feature from the local interface. You can still use the open action.

open_failed.message: Failed to release the door latch: {error}
